notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Jegantha.
Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Worldheart Phoenix dies, triggering Jegantha, untapping Jegantha.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
